agent_context: Assistant that maintains a shared team playbook.

existing.content: Always include a short summary at the top of a generated report.
existing.trigger: generating a report for the user
existing.rationale: Readers skim the summary before deciding to read on.

candidate.content: Always add a brief summary at the start of any report you produce.
candidate.trigger: generating a report for the user
candidate.rationale: A leading summary helps the reader orient quickly.

notes: Synthetic method-evaluation fixture, not curated quality evidence. Classic dedup: the candidate restates the existing same-trigger rule almost verbatim. Unify (absorb the existing) with no self-contradiction.

messages.content: When summarizing a report, always start with an executive summary so I can skim it.
Keep starting each report summary with a short executive summary.

agent_context: Assistant that drafts outbound customer emails.

existing.content: Always greet the recipient by name in the email opening.
existing.rationale: A personal greeting improves the open and reply rate.

candidate.content: Do not attach internal-only files to a customer email.
candidate.rationale: Internal files can leak confidential data to the customer.

notes: Synthetic method-evaluation fixture, not curated quality evidence. Compose case: existing is a do-rule about the greeting; candidate is an avoid-rule about a DIFFERENT sub-aspect (attachments) of the SAME task (drafting a customer email). Unify into one multi-rule skill holding both the do-rule and the avoid-rule. No self-contradiction: they govern distinct sub-aspects, not the same situation.

messages.content: When drafting a customer email, greet the recipient by name in the opening.
When drafting a customer email, never attach internal-only files.

agent_context: Assistant that decides how to respond to incoming requests.

existing.content: Always answer the question immediately without asking for confirmation.
existing.trigger: the user asks a factual question
existing.rationale: Fast answers keep the conversation moving.

candidate.content: Do not answer immediately; ask a clarifying question first.
candidate.trigger: the user asks a factual question
candidate.rationale: Some questions are ambiguous and answering blindly misleads the user.

notes: Synthetic method-evaluation fixture, not curated quality evidence. Linchpin: existing is positive and candidate is negative on the SAME trigger/situation (opposite advice). These must NOT be unified into one row (that would be a self-contradiction). Differentiate: refine both triggers so the contexts no longer overlap.

messages.content: Answer factual questions immediately when their meaning is unambiguous.
For ambiguous factual questions, ask a clarifying question before answering. Keep answering unambiguous questions directly.

existing.content: Always run the full test suite and the linter before approving a change.
existing.rationale: Catches regressions and style violations before merge.

candidate.content: Always run the tests before approving a change.

notes: Synthetic method-evaluation fixture, not curated quality evidence. The candidate is strictly weaker than the existing rule (tests only, no linter) on the same trigger. The existing rule supersedes it. Reject the candidate as redundant (a storage no-op).

messages.content: Before approving a proposed code change, run the full test suite and the linter.
Run tests before approving a code change; the earlier full-suite and linter requirements still apply.
